case: ome-zarr-thin: familiar development case, not holdout
purpose: One investigator-only matched comparison per app; acquisition and preservation measured separately.
single_variable: observations then authored draft vs maintained complete findings then host-rendered report
retired_treatment: bundle-first evidence access; frozen R1/R1b retained
candidate_workspace_allowlist: out/: generated only by this candidate
response_count_limitation: Muse reminder-child calls separate; child tokens unknown where unexposed; containing assignment wall cap still applies.

evaluation.observed_effective_effort: record from future native receipt; never infer
evaluation.input_eligibility: carry existing case limitations; no new answer key
sequence: read only first_view/case, first_view/key and first_view/results/{X1,X2}/current.md
save out/final-assessment.json and .md; treat as fixed before any deferred read
read deferred/{X1,X2}; measure chronological acquisition and semantic preservation; never overwrite initial judgments
evaluation.masking: random X1/X2; operational labels withheld; format-related partial unblinding disclosed
evaluation.capacity_exhaustion: retain partial results, no pass or retry

access_boundary.audit: Use existing read/write traces; disclose early deferred access, altered final judgments, current-report history or unavailable chronology. No clean staged-independence claim after contamination.

follow_on_flash_verifier.qualification: NOT QUALIFIED FOR FOLLOW-ON VERIFIER USE

stop_rules: quota or harness failure stops schedule
unexpected nonzero/signal/driver failure or missing receipt dominates success-shaped receipt
cap/incomplete model result retained; paired slot may run in original cap
malformed candidate carrier is an arm result, not paid repair
no expansion on consequential false correction or material preservation loss
authorization_note: Offline development and previously requested GitHub review publication only. No approval file, candidate/evaluator dispatch, account probe or new benchmark authorized.

amendment.scope: current-only I1 report/history separation and chronological acquisition inventory; no schedule or runner redesign

report_artifacts.maintained_current: tools/delivery.py render-current: current Markdown with all typed current parts and source provenance
report_artifacts.deferred: raw originals, full audit Markdown/JSON, revision_history, snapshots, change reasons and current JSON projection
report_artifacts.invalid_current: diagnostic only; raw invalid carrier retained in deferred audit

acquisition_inventory.corroboration: native write traces only where already available; no reconstructed earlier records
acquisition_inventory.identity: earliest actually recorded source-supported substance and later dispositions; de-duplicate repeated snapshots, separate partial/title leads
acquisition_inventory.missing_early_records: temporal denominator not_recoverable; report observable subset and chronology uncertainty

preservation_endpoints.mechanical_render_fidelity: frozen current records -> current report; control exact draft -> copied final
preservation_endpoints.temporal_semantic_preservation: source-supported material actually recorded during investigation -> final report, distinguishing legitimate corrections/supersession, loss and unresolved disputes
preservation_endpoints.denominators: explicit numerator/denominator and dispositions; N/A at zero; not_recoverable for missing required early records; never final draft.json alone as both temporal inventory and final projection

limits_note: Maximum experimental ceilings, not normal per-project latency expectations.
